thread:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty page fired: INC-2025 embeddings-queue-prod-eu — 5xx rate spike >10% in last 2m. Auto-escalation to SRE rotation.
PagerDuty Bot: Page created: INC-2025. Escalation policy: SRE-Oncall. Paging rotation: Maya -> Luis -> Alex.
Maya (SRE): ack — I'm on it. Opening bridge if we need one.
Luis (SRE): noted. Standing by for logs/tracing.
Maya (SRE): quick check — spike localized to shard eu-3, lots of 503/504s from model runtime. I'll query queue depth and 5xx rate.
Maya (SRE): `curl -s https://monitoring.internal/api/queues/embeddings-prod?shard=eu-3 | jq '.backlog, .rate_5xx'`
Maya (SRE): result: backlog=1.2k, rate_5xx=12.6% :grimacing:
Alex (Infra): autoscale on that pool? I see eu-dedicated-embeds at ~75% util.
Maya (SRE): autoscale is enabled but burst limiter prevented scale. Trying manual scale +1 now.
Alex (Infra): scaling up pool: `rctl scale pool eu-dedicated-embeds +1 --reason \"INC-2025 5xx spike\"` — kicking nodes.
PagerDuty Bot: INC-2025 acknowledged by Maya. Notifying #incidents.
Nina (Support): any customer impact yet? CS dashboard flags AcmeRetail with 500s in last 5m.
Maya (SRE): confirmed — AcmeRetail + a few mid-tier customers hitting timeouts. ETA to stabilize ~6-8m after scale and routing changes.
Luis (SRE): recommendation: enable fallback model variant for EU to reduce backend latency while nodes spin up. I can flip routing.
Maya (SRE): go ahead Luis — route embeddings for eu to fallback variant.
Luis (SRE): running: `redwood-cli route update --kind embedding --region eu --from embedding-base-quant --to embedding-base-fallback`
Luis (SRE): routing change applied to 3/3 edge nodes.
Maya (SRE): observing metrics — 5xx down to 4.1%, backlog -> 220.
Nina (Support): I'll draft and send customer-facing message: "We're aware of elevated errors for embeddings in EU; mitigation in progress; we'll follow up with root cause."
Alex (Infra): scale success confirmed — pool +1 node up, avg util ~58%.
PagerDuty Bot: INC-2025 status update: acknowledged, mitigation in progress.
Maya (SRE): I'll monitor for 15m then hand off to Luis for RCA.
Luis (SRE): I'll pick up at t+15 and own the postmortem. Starting notes checklist.
Maya (SRE): quick logs: seeing transient OOM before crash on eu-3: `ERR OOM when allocating kv-cache` — Alex, can you pull full runtime logs?
Alex (Infra): pulled logs to `/var/logs/embeds/eu-3/2026-03-15_10:23.log` and uploaded to s3://redwood-ops/incidents/INC-2025/eu-3.log
Maya (SRE): added to incident doc. Luis, please include OOM trace + autoscale misfire in RCA.
Nina (Support): will post customer-impact summary in #support-updates once Luis confirms handoff.
Maya (SRE): 5xxs under 1% for 4 consecutive minutes. Marking incident mitigated. Handing to Luis for follow-ups (RCA, comms).
Luis (SRE): taking ownership. Creating postmortem doc with timeline & action items: autoscale tuning, OOM guardrails, routing safety tests, improved alert thresholds.
PagerDuty Bot: INC-2025 status: mitigated -> follow-up owner: Luis (SRE).
Maya (SRE): :thumbsup: great work everyone.
Nina (Support): :white_check_mark: customer emails sent.
Alex (Infra): filing follow-up ticket to review pool SLO and burst limiter rules.
Maya (SRE): closing thread — will update incident doc when the postmortem is ready.
